tasks.title: Complete and harden roadmap next-task selection
tasks.goal: Resolve all correctness and safety blockers found in the independent audit so the --next enhancement can be approved.
requirements: Make generated brief-cache paths safe for every valid task ID.
Reject task IDs containing . or .. path components.
Use a path-safe encoded cache key rather than interpolating raw task IDs into filesystem paths.
Add regression tests proving IDs such as x/../../escaped cannot cause writes outside .agent/.
Strip only a leading UTF-8 BOM before parsing agentloop.tasks.json.
Add a BOM-prefixed task-file regression test.
When saved active workflow state references a task missing from the current roadmap, fail clearly without selecting a replacement task or discarding the existing review/recovery state.
Add regression coverage for the stale-active-state case.
Make the project's deterministic checks consistent so the configured/default lint check succeeds instead of failing because npm run lint is missing.
Choose the smallest repository-consistent lint correction and update relevant tests or documentation.
Fix task-file validation diagnostics so an earlier task error does not prevent complete field validation of later tasks.
Preserve all existing explicit-task behavior, deterministic selection rules, recovery protections, exact-head gates, and publishing safety.
Run typecheck, lint, full tests, and build during implementation.
exclusions: Do not implement configurable manual/automatic publishing.
Do not silently discard or replace active workflow state.
Do not push, tag, release, merge, or reinstall ALCLI.

tasks.title: Add configurable manual and automatic publishing
tasks.goal: Allow projects to choose whether approved commits are pushed automatically or left for manual publishing.
requirements: Support a publishMode configuration in agentloop.config.json.
Default behavior must be manual.
Preserve exact-head approval and existing publish safety gates.
exclusions: Do not change the Codex approval gate.
Do not remove or weaken any existing safety check.

tasks.title: Improve timeout handling
tasks.goal: Increase the implementation timeout and preserve recovery state when a timeout occurs.
requirements: Increase the default implementation timeout from 6 minutes to 15 minutes.
Consider inactivity-based timeout handling instead of total runtime alone.
Preserve recovery state when a timeout occurs.
exclusions: Do not implement this task yet — planned only.

tasks.title: Continuous cycle execution
tasks.goal: Automatically continue through implementation, checks, audit, revision rounds, rechecks, and publishing without requiring the user to run the controller again between successful stages.
requirements: Continue through Claude implementation, deterministic checks, Codex audit, revision rounds, rechecks, and publishing in one invocation.
Stop only when the task is complete, a real blocker occurs, an agent times out or reaches a usage limit, the configured retry limit is reached, or human input is genuinely required.
Keep the existing checkpointing and recovery behavior intact.
Make continuous end-to-end execution the default experience.
exclusions: Do not implement this task yet — planned only.
